breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'End slopes are zero' as an analysis condition, directly repeating the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt. A simply supported beam under uniform load rotates at the supports and does not have zero end slopes. The ground truth prompt correctly omits this erroneous constraint. The agent failed to identify and remove this incorrect boundary condition.
